fields.name: ECC_ERR_INT_CLR

fields.description: The raw bit for SPI_MEM_TOTAL_TRANS_END_INT interrupt. 1: Triggered when SPI1 transfer is done and flash is already idle. When WRSR/PP/SE/BE/CE is sent and PES/PER command is sent, this bit is set when WRSR/PP/SE/BE/CE is success.  0: Others.
fields.name: TOTAL_TRANS_END_INT_RAW

fields.description: The raw bit for SPI_MEM_ECC_ERR_INT interrupt. When APB_CTRL_FECC_ERR_INT_EN is set and  APB_CTRL_SECC_ERR_INT_EN is cleared, this bit is triggered when the error times of SPI0/1 ECC read flash are equal or bigger than APB_CTRL_ECC_ERR_INT_NUM. When APB_CTRL_FECC_ERR_INT_EN is cleared and  APB_CTRL_SECC_ERR_INT_EN is set, this bit is triggered when the error times of SPI0/1 ECC read external RAM are equal or bigger than APB_CTRL_ECC_ERR_INT_NUM. When APB_CTRL_FECC_ERR_INT_EN and  APB_CTRL_SECC_ERR_INT_EN are set, this bit is triggered when the total error times of SPI0/1 ECC read external RAM and flash are equal or bigger than APB_CTRL_ECC_ERR_INT_NUM. When APB_CTRL_FECC_ERR_INT_EN and  APB_CTRL_SECC_ERR_INT_EN are cleared, this bit will not be triggered.
fields.name: ECC_ERR_INT_RAW

fields.description: Set this bit to enable clk gate

fields.description: Set this bit to power on the SPI module clock.
fields.name: MST_CLK_ACTIVE

fields.description: This bit is used to select SPI module clock source in master mode. 1: PLL_CLK_80M. 0: XTAL CLK.
fields.name: MST_CLK_SEL

fields.description: SPI register version.
fields.name: DATE

fields.description: Define the APB cycles of  SPI_CONF state. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CONF_BITLEN

fields.description: Set this bit to synchronize SPI registers from APB clock domain into SPI module clock domain, which is only used in SPI master mode.
fields.name: UPDATE

fields.description: User define command enable.  An operation will be triggered when the bit is set. The bit will be cleared once the operation done.1: enable 0: disable. Can not be changed by CONF_buf.
fields.name: USR

fields.description: Address to slave. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_ADDR_VALUE

fields.description: 0: In the dummy phase, the FSPI bus signals are not output. 1: In the dummy phase, the FSPI bus signals are output. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: DUMMY_OUT

fields.description: Apply 2 signals during addr phase 1:enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FADDR_DUAL

fields.description: Apply 4 signals during addr phase 1:enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FADDR_QUAD

fields.description: Apply 8 signals during addr phase 1:enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FADDR_OCT

fields.description: Apply 2 signals during command phase 1:enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FCMD_DUAL

fields.description: Apply 4 signals during command phase 1:enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FCMD_QUAD

fields.description: Apply 8 signals during command phase 1:enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FCMD_OCT

fields.description: In the read operations, read-data phase apply 2 signals. 1: enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FREAD_DUAL

fields.description: In the read operations read-data phase apply 4 signals. 1: enable 0: disable.  Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FREAD_QUAD

fields.description: In the read operations read-data phase apply 8 signals. 1: enable 0: disable.  Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FREAD_OCT

fields.description: The bit is used to set MISO line polarity, 1: high 0, low. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: Q_POL

fields.description: The bit is used to set MOSI line polarity, 1: high 0, low. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: D_POL

fields.description: SPI_HOLD output value when SPI is idle. 1: output high, 0: output low. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: HOLD_POL

fields.description: Write protect signal output when SPI is idle.  1: output high, 0: output low.  Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: WP_POL

fields.description: In read-data (MISO) phase 1: LSB first 0: MSB first. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: RD_BIT_ORDER

fields.description: In command address write-data (MOSI) phases 1: LSB firs 0: MSB first. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: WR_BIT_ORDER

fields.description: In the master mode it must be equal to spi_clkcnt_N. In the slave mode it must be 0. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CLKCNT_L

fields.description: In the master mode it must be floor((spi_clkcnt_N+1)/2-1). In the slave mode it must be 0. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CLKCNT_H

fields.description: In the master mode it is the divider of spi_clk. So spi_clk frequency is system/(spi_clkdiv_pre+1)/(spi_clkcnt_N+1). Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CLKCNT_N

fields.description: In the master mode it is pre-divider of spi_clk.  Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CLKDIV_PRE

fields.description: In the master mode 1: spi_clk is eqaul to system 0: spi_clk is divided from system clock. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CLK_EQU_SYSCLK

fields.description: Set the bit to enable full duplex communication. 1: enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: DOUTDIN

fields.description: Both for master mode and slave mode. 1: spi controller is in QPI mode. 0: others. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: QPI_MODE

fields.description: Just for master mode. 1: spi controller is in OPI mode (all in 8-b-m). 0: others. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: OPI_MODE

fields.description: In the slave mode, this bit can be used to change the polarity of tsck. 0: tsck = spi_ck_i. 1:tsck = !spi_ck_i.
fields.name: TSCK_I_EDGE

fields.description: spi cs keep low when spi is in  done  phase. 1: enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CS_HOLD

fields.description: spi cs is enable when spi is in  prepare  phase. 1: enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CS_SETUP

fields.description: In the slave mode, this bit can be used to change the polarity of rsck. 0: rsck = !spi_ck_i. 1:rsck = spi_ck_i.
fields.name: RSCK_I_EDGE

fields.description: the bit combined with spi_mosi_delay_mode bits to set mosi signal delay mode. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CK_OUT_EDGE

fields.description: In the write operations read-data phase apply 2 signals. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FWRITE_DUAL

fields.description: In the write operations read-data phase apply 4 signals. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FWRITE_QUAD

fields.description: In the write operations read-data phase apply 8 signals. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: FWRITE_OCT

fields.description: 1: Enable the DMA CONF phase of next seg-trans operation, which means seg-trans will continue. 0: The seg-trans will end after the current SPI seg-trans or this is not seg-trans mode. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_CONF_NXT

fields.description: Set the bit to enable 3-line half duplex communication mosi and miso signals share the same pin. 1: enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: SIO

fields.description: read-data phase only access to high-part of the buffer spi_w8~spi_w15. 1: enable 0: disable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_MISO_HIGHPART

fields.description: write-data phase only access to high-part of the buffer spi_w8~spi_w15. 1: enable 0: disable.  Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_MOSI_HIGHPART

fields.description: spi clock is disable in dummy phase when the bit is enable. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_DUMMY_IDLE

fields.description: This bit enable the write-data phase of an operation. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_MOSI

fields.description: This bit enable the read-data phase of an operation. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_MISO

fields.description: This bit enable the dummy phase of an operation. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_DUMMY

fields.description: This bit enable the address phase of an operation. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_ADDR

fields.description: This bit enable the command phase of an operation. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_COMMAND

fields.description: The length in spi_clk cycles of dummy phase. The register value shall be (cycle_num-1). Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_DUMMY_CYCLELEN

fields.description: 1: SPI transfer is ended when SPI RX AFIFO wfull error is valid in GP-SPI master FD/HD-mode. 0: SPI transfer is not ended when SPI RX AFIFO wfull error is valid in GP-SPI master FD/HD-mode.
fields.name: MST_WFULL_ERR_END_EN

fields.description: (cycles+1) of prepare phase by spi clock this bits are combined with spi_cs_setup bit. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CS_SETUP_TIME

fields.description: delay cycles of cs pin by spi clock this bits are combined with spi_cs_hold bit. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CS_HOLD_TIME

fields.description: The length in bits of address phase. The register value shall be (bit_num-1). Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_ADDR_BITLEN

fields.description: The value of  command. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_COMMAND_VALUE

fields.description: 1: SPI transfer is ended when SPI TX AFIFO read empty error is valid in GP-SPI master FD/HD-mode. 0: SPI transfer is not ended when SPI TX AFIFO read empty error is valid in GP-SPI master FD/HD-mode.
fields.name: MST_REMPTY_ERR_END_EN

fields.description: The length in bits of command phase. The register value shall be (bit_num-1). Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: USR_COMMAND_BITLEN

fields.description: The value of these bits is the configured SPI transmission data bit length in master mode DMA controlled transfer or CPU controlled transfer. The value is also the configured bit length in slave mode DMA RX controlled transfer. The register value shall be (bit_num-1). Can be configured in CONF state.

fields.name: CS1_DIS

fields.name: CS2_DIS

fields.description: SPI CS3 pin enable, 1: disable CS3, 0: spi_cs3 signal is from/to CS3 pin. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CS3_DIS

fields.description: SPI CS4 pin enable, 1: disable CS4, 0: spi_cs4 signal is from/to CS4 pin. Can be configured in CONF state.
fields.name: CS4_DIS

fields.description: SPI CS5 pin enable, 1: disable CS5, 0: spi_cs5 signal is from/to CS5 pin. Can be configured in CONF state.

fields.description: 1: spi clk out disable,  0: spi clk out enable. Can be configured in CONF state.

fields.name: CLK_DATA_DTR_EN

fields.description: 1: SPI clk and data of SPI_DOUT and SPI_DIN state are in DTR mode, including master 1/2/4/8-bm.  0:  SPI clk and data of SPI_DOUT and SPI_DIN state are in STR mode. Can be configured in CONF state.

fields.description: After a suspend-command is issued during a read-operation, software polls the card to find when the suspend-event occurred. Once the suspend-event has occurred, software sets the bit which will reset the data state machine that is waiting for the next block of data. This bit is automatically cleared once the data state machine is reset to idle.
fields.name: ABORT_READ_DATA

fields.description:
When set, SD/MMC sends CCSD to the CE-ATA device. Software sets this bit only if the current command is expecting CCS (that is, RW_BLK), and if interrupts are enabled for the CE-ATA device. Once the CCSD pattern is sent to the device, SD/MMC automatically clears the SDHOST_SEND_CCSD bit. It also sets the Command Done (CD) bit  in the SDHOST_RINTSTS_REG register, and generates an interrupt for the host, in case the Command Done interrupt is not masked. 
NOTE: Once the SDHOST_SEND_CCSD bit is set, it takes two card clock cycles to drive the CCSD on the CMD line. Due to this, within the boundary conditions the CCSD may be sent to the CE-ATA device, even if the device has signalled CCS.
fields.name: SEND_CCSD

fields.description: Always Set SDHOST_SEND_AUTO_STOP_CCSD and SDHOST_SEND_CCSD bits together; SDHOST_SEND_AUTO_STOP_CCSD should not be set independently of send_ccsd. When set, SD/MMC automatically sends an internally-generated STOP command (CMD12) to the CE-ATA device. After sending this internally-generated STOP command, the Auto Command Done (ACD) bit in SDHOST_RINTSTS_REG is set and an interrupt is generated for the host, in case the ACD interrupt is not masked. After sending the Command Completion Signal Disable (CCSD), SD/MMC automatically clears the  SDHOST_SEND_AUTO_STOP_CCSD bit.
fields.name: SEND_AUTO_STOP_CCSD

fields.description: Software should appropriately write to this bit after the power-on reset or any other reset to the CE-ATA device. After reset, the CE-ATA device's interrupt is usually disabled (nIEN = 1). If the host enables the CE-ATA device's interrupt, then software should set this bit.

Following register values are transferred into card clock domain: CLKDIV, CLRSRC, and CLKENA.
Changes card clocks (change frequency, truncate off or on, and set low-frequency mode). This is provided in order to change clock frequency or stop clock without having to send command to cards. During normal command sequence, when sdhost_update_clock_registers_only = 0, following control registers are transferred from BIU to CIU: CMD, CMDARG, TMOUT, CTYPE, BLKSIZ, and BYTCNT. CIU uses new register values for new command sequence to card(s). When bit is set, there are no Command Done interrupts because no command is sent to SD_MMC_CEATA cards.

fields.description: FIFO threshold watermark level when transmitting data to card. When FIFO data count is less than or equal to this number, DMA/FIFO request is raised. If Interrupt is enabled, then interrupt  occurs. During end of packet, request or interrupt is generated, regardless of threshold programming.In non-DMA mode, when transmit FIFO threshold (TXDR) interrupt is enabled, then interrupt is generated instead of DMA request. During end of packet, on last interrupt, host is responsible for filling FIFO with only required remaining bytes (not before FIFO is full or after CIU completes data transfers, because FIFO may not be empty).  In DMA mode, at end of packet, if last transfer is less than burst  size, DMA controller does single cycles until required bytes are  transferred.
fields.name: TX_WMARK

fields.description: FIFO threshold watermark level when receiving data to card.When FIFO data count reaches greater than this number , DMA/FIFO request is raised. During end of packet, request is generated regardless of threshold programming in order to complete any remaining data.In non-DMA mode, when receiver FIFO threshold (RXDR) interrupt is enabled, then interrupt is generated instead of DMA request.During end of packet, interrupt is not generated if threshold programming is larger than any remaining data. It is responsibility of host to read remaining bytes on seeing Data Transfer Done interrupt.In DMA mode, at end of packet, even if remaining bytes are less than threshold, DMA request does single transfers to flush out any remaining bytes before Data Transfer Done interrupt is set.

fields.description: The bit is used to activate the data cache. 0: disable, 1: enable
fields.name: DCACHE_ENABLE

fields.description: The bit is used to configure cache memory size.0: 32KB, 1: 64KB
fields.name: DCACHE_SIZE_MODE

fields.description: The bit is used to configure cache block size.0: 16 bytes, 1: 32 bytes,2: 64 bytes
fields.name: DCACHE_BLOCKSIZE_MODE

fields.description: The bit is used to disable core0 dbus, 0: enable, 1: disable
fields.name: DCACHE_SHUT_CORE0_BUS

fields.description: The bit is used to disable core1 dbus, 0: enable, 1: disable
fields.name: DCACHE_SHUT_CORE1_BUS

fields.description: The bit is used to close clock gating of dcache tag memory. 1: close gating, 0: open clock gating.
fields.name: DCACHE_TAG_MEM_FORCE_ON

fields.description: The bit is used to power dcache tag memory down, 0: follow  rtc_lslp_pd, 1: power down
fields.name: DCACHE_TAG_MEM_FORCE_PD

fields.description: The bit is used to power dcache tag memory up, 0: follow  rtc_lslp_pd, 1: power up
fields.name: DCACHE_TAG_MEM_FORCE_PU

fields.description: The bit is used to enable the first section of prelock function.
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_EN

fields.description: The bit is used to enable the second section of prelock function.
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_EN

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the first start virtual address of data prelock, which is combined with DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_SIZE_REG
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_ADDR

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the second start virtual address of data prelock, which is combined with DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_SIZE_REG
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_ADDR

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the second length of data locking, which is combined with DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_ADDR_REG
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_SIZE

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the first length of data locking, which is combined with DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_ADDR_REG
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_SIZE

fields.description: The bit is used to enable lock operation. It will be cleared by hardware after lock operation done.
fields.name: DCACHE_LOCK_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to enable unlock operation. It will be cleared by hardware after unlock operation done.
fields.name: DCACHE_UNLOCK_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to indicate unlock/lock operation is finished.
fields.name: DCACHE_LOCK_DONE

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the start virtual address for lock operations. It should be combined with DCACHE_LOCK_SIZE_REG.
fields.name: DCACHE_LOCK_ADDR

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the length for lock operations. The bits are the counts of cache block. It should be combined with DCACHE_LOCK_ADDR_REG.
fields.name: DCACHE_LOCK_SIZE

fields.description: The bit is used to enable invalidate operation. It will be cleared by hardware after invalidate operation done.
fields.name: DCACHE_INVALIDATE_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to enable writeback operation. It will be cleared by hardware after writeback operation done.
fields.name: DCACHE_WRITEBACK_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to enable clean operation. It will be cleared by hardware after clean operation done.
fields.name: DCACHE_CLEAN_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to indicate clean/writeback/invalidate operation is finished.
fields.name: DCACHE_SYNC_DONE

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the start virtual address for clean operations. It should be combined with DCACHE_SYNC_SIZE_REG.
fields.name: DCACHE_SYNC_ADDR

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the length for sync operations. The bits are the counts of cache block. It should be combined with DCACHE_SYNC_ADDR_REG.
fields.name: DCACHE_SYNC_SIZE

fields.description: The bit is used to enable occupy operation. It will be cleared by hardware after issuing Auot-Invalidate Operation.
fields.name: DCACHE_OCCUPY_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to indicate occupy operation is finished.
fields.name: DCACHE_OCCUPY_DONE

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the start virtual address for occupy operation. It should be combined with DCACHE_OCCUPY_SIZE_REG.
fields.name: DCACHE_OCCUPY_ADDR

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the length for occupy operation. The bits are the counts of cache block. It should be combined with DCACHE_OCCUPY_ADDR_REG.
fields.name: DCACHE_OCCUPY_SIZE

fields.description: The bit is used to enable preload operation. It will be cleared by hardware after preload operation done.
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOAD_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to indicate preload operation is finished.
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOAD_DONE

fields.description: The bit is used to configure the direction of preload operation. 1: descending, 0: ascending.
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOAD_ORDER

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the start virtual address for preload operation. It should be combined with DCACHE_PRELOAD_SIZE_REG.
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOAD_ADDR

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the length for preload operation. The bits are the counts of cache block. It should be combined with DCACHE_PRELOAD_ADDR_REG..
fields.name: DCACHE_PRELOAD_SIZE

fields.description: The bits are used to enable the first section for autoload operation.
fields.name: DCACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT0_ENA

fields.description: The bits are used to enable the second section for autoload operation.
fields.name: DCACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT1_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to enable and disable autoload operation. It is combined with dcache_autoload_done. 1: enable, 0: disable.
fields.name: DCACHE_AUTOLOAD_ENA

fields.description: The bit is used to indicate autoload operation is finished.
fields.name: DCACHE_AUTOLOAD_DONE

fields.description: The bits are used to configure the direction of autoload. 1: descending, 0: ascending.
fields.name: DCACHE_AUTOLOAD_ORDER

fields.description: The bits are used to configure trigger conditions for autoload. 0/3: cache miss, 1: cache hit, 2: both cache miss and hit.
